title: bulbophyllum zophyranthum
intro: Bulbophyllum zophyranthum, commonly known as the "Garden Orchid", is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its reported health benefits of reducing fever and soothing coughs. The therapeutic actions of Bulbophyllum zophyranthum include its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating infections and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
